findings.title: Relief Becomes Hostile Reception
findings.claim: The focus presents reception as an inverted refuge: the enclosing fire contains the wrongdoers, relief arrives as a liquid that sears, and the named resting place is condemned.
findings.mechanism: The focus's enclosure, fire, relief-request, water, molten-substance, roasting, drink, and resting-place carriers contact one another; the paired ordinary affordances of shelter, aid, drink, and rest are recast by the fire-and-searing triggers as confinement and injury.
findings.reader_payoff: The punishment scene becomes a coherent failure of refuge rather than a list of separate torments.
findings.containment: This integrates the focus's own reception imagery; it does not claim that every surrounding ayah or every use of these roots carries the inversion.
